listing.name: Tekken Tag Tournament 2 — TTT2 Native Online (naleqs)
listing.summary: early development: native menus at 60 FPS/select/intros/fights,localversus; online is lockstep/inputdelay; rollback is unfinished, music/voices silent. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own TekkenTagTournament2 USA/Europe Xbox360 ISO/extractedfolder; all gamefiles checked against the expected checksum, modified/other revisions are refused. Optional userTU3 andDLC; older title updates are ignored. Exact the exact fingerprint manifest is not included here.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Release TTT2NativeOnline.exe Setupthegame or source Setup.bat; verifies/copies ownfiles, fetches checked against the expected SHA-256 portable compiler(~250MB), translates Default.xexandcompiles into native/bin. Windows 10/11 x64AVX2,D3D11. Rebuild after codeupdates retains verified data.

warnings: early development: native menus at 60 FPS/select/intros/fights,localversus; online is lockstep/inputdelay; rollback is unfinished, music/voices silent.
